title.value: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Community-Based Primary Health Care: Systematic Scoping Review and Critical Appraisal

analysis.description: The paper provides a comprehensive systematic scoping review on the integration of Artificial Intelligence in community-based primary health care (CBPHC). It summarizes existing studies that have tested or implemented AI methods, evaluates the effects of AI systems, and critically appraises current studies to offer directions for future research.

type.justification: The study conducts a systematic scoping review which collects, evaluates, and synthesizes existing empirical studies on AI implementations in CBPHC.
type.quote: We conducted a comprehensive systematic scoping review that included 90 studies on the use of AI systems in CBPHC and provided a critical appraisal of the current studies in this area.

name.justification: The research is heavily focused on the integration of AI into healthcare, specifically within the domain of primary health care systems.
